summary: A useful safety net layers fast local hooks with repository tests, static analysis, security and policy checks, then makes the same named results mandatory in CI. Tools provide signals; branch policy turns them into a gate.

items.text: GitHub protected branches can require uniquely identified status checks, up-to-date branches, reviews, conversation resolution, and merge-queue validation before code reaches a protected branch.
pre-commit installs repository-configured, language-independent hooks and runs them consistently before commits or across all files, providing a fast local lint, format, and policy layer.
pytest provides automatic test discovery, fixtures, parametrization, markers, and selectable subsets, supporting one-command local checks plus focused feature suites.
mypy performs configurable static type checking and can run incrementally locally or as a strict CI gate, catching interface inconsistencies without executing the changed path.
Semgrep CI scans changed code with versioned static-analysis and security rules and can block findings according to rule and policy configuration.
Conftest evaluates configuration files against Rego policies from a repository, making infrastructure, deployment, and governance constraints executable in local and CI workflows.
